subject: [PATCH 15/60] mm/page_alloc: count common memory nodes for kswapd recovery

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to improve the Linux kernel's memory management by introducing a new approach for kswapd recovery. The goal is to optimize the handling of memory nodes during zone recovery, ensuring that allocations can fall back to other nodes without triggering direct reclaim. This specific patch modifies the free_frozen_page_commit function in mm/page_alloc.c to count common memory nodes instead of total memory nodes.
